reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need sachets to carry around. I'd be paying $30 for convenience I don't use.
objection: I already have a magnesium bottle on my nightstand that costs less. Individual sachets solve a problem I don't have.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing a real situation where I'd need it away from home, like travel, plus a price close to what my bottle costs per day.
